title: India's Got Latent
overview: Samay Raina and guest judges hilariously critique the untapped talents of aspiring performers, testing their self-awareness with a unique scoring system.

episodes.title: India's Got Latent — Episode 1
episodes.plot: Alia Bhatt, Sharvari, and Ashish Solanki join the show for a round of unpredictable talent performances, sharp humour, and candid judging.

episodes.title: India's Got Latent — Episode 2
episodes.plot: Chandan Prabhakar, Kiku Sharda, Balraj Ghai, and Harssh Limbachiyaa appear alongside aspiring performers in a comedy-filled talent judging session.

episodes.title: India's Got Latent — Episode 4
episodes.plot: • Kuch contestants aakar gusse mein apni talent dikhate hain. Raghu unhe apne puraane Roadies wale style mein sunate hain, aur Rakhi bich mein apna alag hi emotional drama shuru kar deti hai, jise dekh kar Balraj aur Samay apna sir pakad lete hain.

episodes.title: India's Got Latent — Episode 5
episodes.plot: Contestants ajeeb physical skills aur calculation tricks dikhate hain. Samay aur Chahal milkar chess aur cricket par jokes crack karte hain, jabki Vishy Anand contestants ki prediction aur self-rating strategy ko mathematically dissect karte hain.

episodes.title: India's Got Latent — Episode 6
episodes.plot: • Aise singers aur rappers aate hain jinki aawaz sunkar Anu Malik apna iconic
bolne ke bajaye stage chhodne ki baat karte hain. Badshah contestants ke beats ko sahi karne ki koshish karta hai aur Solanki shanti se aakar unhe reality check deta hai.

episodes.title: India's Got Latent — Episode 7
episodes.plot: Contestants aisi talents late hain jo hamare ghar ke shadi-byah mein dekhne ko milti hain (jaise naagin dance ki 5 alag variations). Johnny Lever apni iconic mimicry se sabko hasate hain aur Archana bina ruke thahake lagati hain.

episodes.title: India's Got Latent — Episode 8
episodes.plot: Gen-Z contestants aakar modern lingo aur aesthetic talents dikhate hain, jise dekh kar Bhuvan aur Rahul Dua bilkul blank ho jaate hain. Orry contestants ke
aur energy ko apne style mein rate karta hai.

episodes.title: India's Got Latent — Episode 9
episodes.plot: Contestants thodi dark, artistic, aur bohot hi ajeeb poetry ya acting pieces perform karte hain. Nawazuddin shanti se unhe gehri nazron se dekhte hain aur ek line mein aisi acting ka nirdesh dete hain ki contestant ka khud ka confidence hil jata hai.
